speaker: Talulah
content: They were inspired by a lie, but their determination to fight back is certainly real.

raw: [name="Nine"]So they gave you the courage to recall the good old days?
speaker: Nine
content: So they gave you the courage to recall the good old days?

raw: [name="Talulah"]...It's not only Infected over there. There are students, exiled officers and soldiers, guilt-ridden nobles...
speaker: Talulah
content: ...It's not only Infected over there. There are students, exiled officers and soldiers, guilt-ridden nobles...

speaker: Talulah
content: It's exactly the strength you need.

raw: [name="Talulah"]Strength that ignores the differences in race or identity and crushes the fear of disease, united by a common goal.
speaker: Talulah
content: Strength that ignores the differences in race or identity and crushes the fear of disease, united by a common goal.

raw: [name="Talulah"]Besides, it'll take time to leave with this many people... and I think that should be long enough for you to explain Guard's precious dream to those still willing to follow you.
speaker: Talulah
content: Besides, it'll take time to leave with this many people... and I think that should be long enough for you to explain Guard's precious dream to those still willing to follow you.

raw: [name="Nine"]...You don't want to restore Reunion's reputation?
speaker: Nine
content: ...You don't want to restore Reunion's reputation?

raw: [name="Talulah"]No. I never expected it to hold such a large influence even today.
speaker: Talulah
content: No. I never expected it to hold such a large influence even today.

raw: [name="Talulah"]Even if the Ursus Empire has long since covered up what happened at Chernobog.
speaker: Talulah
content: Even if the Ursus Empire has long since covered up what happened at Chernobog.

raw: [name="Nine"]The voices craving resistance are like water. They might be burnt and dry up, but they'll eventually return to the land as rain.
speaker: Nine
content: The voices craving resistance are like water. They might be burnt and dry up, but they'll eventually return to the land as rain.

raw: [name="Ch'en"]Returning to Ursus is easier said than done. There are too many factors involved, and more things for me to confirm.
speaker: Ch'en
content: Returning to Ursus is easier said than done. There are too many factors involved, and more things for me to confirm.

speaker: Nine
content: That's your problem. Not ours.

speaker: Nine
content: Talulah...

raw: [name="Nine"]Even if Reunion can turn a new leaf, representing once again freedom and happiness...
speaker: Nine
content: Even if Reunion can turn a new leaf, representing once again freedom and happiness...

raw: [name="Nine"]What about you, Talulah? Your sins can't be washed away. Your existence is Reunion's darkest history.
speaker: Nine
content: What about you, Talulah? Your sins can't be washed away. Your existence is Reunion's darkest history.

raw: [name="Nine"]How can you face the pure-white tundra as you are?
speaker: Nine
content: How can you face the pure-white tundra as you are?

raw: [name="Talulah"]I know that I stand here today no longer as a leader, but as a symbol, a flag, or even... a weapon to be wielded.
speaker: Talulah
content: I know that I stand here today no longer as a leader, but as a symbol, a flag, or even... a weapon to be wielded.

raw: [name="Talulah"]But I'll take it. I'll accept the shackles you place on me. I've had many different identities—Draco, noble, leader, Infected... None of these matter anymore.
speaker: Talulah
content: But I'll take it. I'll accept the shackles you place on me. I've had many different identities—Draco, noble, leader, Infected... None of these matter anymore.

raw: [name="Talulah"]Today I remain only someone who once scattered the seeds of sin.
speaker: Talulah
content: Today I remain only someone who once scattered the seeds of sin.

raw: [name="Talulah"]The wrongs I committed in Ursus, I will repay in Ursus.
speaker: Talulah
content: The wrongs I committed in Ursus, I will repay in Ursus.

raw: [name="Nine"]Repay... you make it sound so simple.
speaker: Nine
content: Repay... you make it sound so simple.

raw: [name="Talulah"]I will not act as just a flag this time.
speaker: Talulah
content: I will not act as just a flag this time.

speaker: Nine
content: Then how?

raw: [name="Talulah"]I'll throw myself into a true blaze and let it all burn, until even the tundra's chill melts away.
speaker: Talulah
content: I'll throw myself into a true blaze and let it all burn, until even the tundra's chill melts away.

raw: [name="Talulah"]I'll go back to Ursus... to truly face my own trial.
speaker: Talulah
content: I'll go back to Ursus... to truly face my own trial.

raw: [name="Talulah"]And you can be there to witness it, Nine.
speaker: Talulah
content: And you can be there to witness it, Nine.

raw: [name="Talulah"]Witness the end of Reunion, and the birth of something new from its corpse. That's what you truly want, is it not?
speaker: Talulah
content: Witness the end of Reunion, and the birth of something new from its corpse. That's what you truly want, is it not?

speaker: Nine
content: You really don't mind?

raw: [name="Talulah"]The Reunion of my heart died long ago on the tundra... along with my companions.
speaker: Talulah
content: The Reunion of my heart died long ago on the tundra... along with my companions.

speaker: Ch'en
content: I'll go with you.

speaker: Talulah
content: Scared I'll harm more innocents?

speaker: Ch'en
content: Both you and Nine.

raw: [name="Ch'en"]After following Reunion for a while, I can confirm that the group has changed somewhat.
speaker: Ch'en
content: After following Reunion for a while, I can confirm that the group has changed somewhat.

raw: [name="Ch'en"]For good or bad... I can't say.
speaker: Ch'en
content: For good or bad... I can't say.

raw: [name="Ch'en"]I don't want to miss your trial, but I also don't want to jump to any hasty conclusions about whether the path Nine insists on is correct.
speaker: Ch'en
content: I don't want to miss your trial, but I also don't want to jump to any hasty conclusions about whether the path Nine insists on is correct.

raw: [name="Ch'en"]From now on, I'll keep an eye on you as Rhodes Island Operator Ch'en.
speaker: Ch'en
content: From now on, I'll keep an eye on you as Rhodes Island Operator Ch'en.

raw: [name="Ch'en"]I need to keep Rhodes Island informed, no matter what happens in Ursus.
speaker: Ch'en
content: I need to keep Rhodes Island informed, no matter what happens in Ursus.

raw: [name="Ch'en"]Talulah, Nine... I'm responsible for you both.
speaker: Ch'en
content: Talulah, Nine... I'm responsible for you both.

speaker: Nine
content: ...Whatever.

raw: [name="Ch'en"]Now, you should probably get going. Leave the soldiers to me. I'll catch up after I make sure they're okay.
speaker: Ch'en
content: Now, you should probably get going. Leave the soldiers to me. I'll catch up after I make sure they're okay.

raw: [name="Nine"]We didn't say we'd wait for you.
speaker: Nine
content: We didn't say we'd wait for you.

raw: [name="Ch'en"]Have you ever? I've always had to catch up on my own.
speaker: Ch'en
content: Have you ever? I've always had to catch up on my own.

speaker: Nine
content: Hmph.

speaker: Nine
content: Onwards to Ursus then.

speaker: Talulah
content: Onwards to Ursus.

raw: The flames continue to spread slowly from the tip of the blade.
content: The flames continue to spread slowly from the tip of the blade.

raw: Hot flames lick the bodies piled up in a corner, gently enveloping them.
content: Hot flames lick the bodies piled up in a corner, gently enveloping them.

raw: Amid the light crackling of the fire, Talulah silently prays for the flames to bring them to a brighter and warmer place.
content: Amid the light crackling of the fire, Talulah silently prays for the flames to bring them to a brighter and warmer place.
